rationale: Source is a rich brainstorm with additive intent (build a generic connections core) and an explicit verification mandate (R1-R6). Wiki orientation already shows a CredentialBroker (FEAT-264), generic OAuth2 callback routes, an OAuth2 provider registry, IdentityStore/IdentityMappingService, VaultTokenSync and Slack/Teams/Telegram Jira commands exist — the plan verifies every claimed artifact against those real modules and locates the true gaps (web connections UI, principal-keyed vault consolidation, event-driven completion).
